title: Isaac for Healthcare general batch parameters v2

workflow.description: Any discovered upstream or project-authored workflow. Null selects project.json default_workflow.

mode.description: Any mode authored by the selected workflow. Null preserves its upstream/project default, which may be idle. For an automatic demo with agent-selected settings, inspect available modes and choose an explicit supported unattended mode. Preserve user-selected modes and project defaults.

episode_steps.description: Null preserves the resolved scene/mode cap. An explicit value may only lower that authored cap; there is no global 600-step limit.

physics.description: Null preserves the selected scene backend. Explicit settings are passed unchanged to upstream.

checkpoint.description: Path relative to the extracted project archive; absolute paths, parent traversal and symlinks are rejected.

dataset.description: Path relative to the extracted project archive; absolute paths, parent traversal and symlinks are rejected.

patient_twin.description: Path relative to the extracted project archive; absolute paths, parent traversal and symlinks are rejected.

workflow_args.description: JSON keyword arguments for the authored workflow mode builder; upstream validation and Python signatures remain authoritative.

training.title: Isaac for Healthcare upstream RL options

profile.description: RL profile YAML relative to the effective SDK root; null selects rl/profiles/<workflow>.yaml. User-authored profiles are supported.

epochs.description: Maximum training iterations/epochs; null preserves the profile default.

episodes.description: Evaluation episode count; null preserves upstream default20.

overrides.description: Upstream KEY=VALUE trainer overrides, passed as separate argv entries; unsupported combinations fail upstream.

resume_dir.description: Supported upstream trainer run directory relative to the project archive; RSL-RL resume is unsupported upstream.

train_config.description: RLinf resolved trainer YAML relative to the project archive for export.

runtime_python.description: Explicit installed trainer interpreter for a separately provisioned policy environment. Null uses the configured Arena interpreter for RSL-RL; RLinf requires its own installed environment.

sim_runtime_python.description: Installed simulator interpreter for the isolated RLinf backend; not accepted by RSL-RL.

robot.description: Upstream or project-authored robot descriptor name; required for conversion.

repo_id.description: LeRobot dataset identifier written locally; this operation does not publish it.
